Conversely, if you have [Jester's Arts Skill], you add +1d6 to [Chant Skill], [Deception Skill], [Party Skill] and [Dancing Skill] for their other uses. That can be applied to Checks corresponding even if originally not affected by [Jester's Arts Skill]. (Bard's various Chants is direcly a Chant Check and don't need this skill but benefit from [Jester's Arts Skill] that way if you have it.)

An offensive dance that hit with rythm. Perform a Close-combat weapon attack against all the chosen target. If you inflict 1 HP of damage by that attack, apply Dazzed on the target. That attack have a Range equal to your Movement and can be used even against targets outside your Engagement. You do not move. The effects of Mount on the Movement is not counted for the Range. Critical : Add Dices.

A dance with no name. The target performs a Mind opposition check. Roll (SL)d6, the target who failed the opposition check gets a debuff depending of the result of each dice separately. 1: Intimidated, 2: Enraged, 3: Fear, 4: Off-balance, 5: Enchained, 6: You choose the debuff between the other 5 possibilites. If multiple rolled dice have the same score (other than 6), you treat one of them like a 6 instead, until you have only differents results or 6. The effect of Mount on the Movement is not counted for the Range. Critical: Cost 0.

A dance that brings the ball to a close. You perform again all the "Dance" skills that you performed in the lasts fives Rounds, one after another (you can choose new targets). The cost of this skill is equal to half the total cost of all the "Dance" realized. After that, you cannot use any "Dance" Skill until the end of this Scene.

An offensive dance that overwhelms with attacks. Perform a Close-combat weapon attack against the target. If they have less Actions Points than you, you perform a second Close-combat weapon attack against the target. Critical: Add dices.

An aerial dance where the dancer jumps in all directions, including over heads. The target gets -1d6 to all Reactions checks until the end of this Round. If the target are in the Flying state, the effect change: They loose the Flying State and their Actions Points are reduce by -1d6 and they gets -1d6 to all Reactions checks, that effect last until the end of the Scene instead (can be canceled by effect that restore from Debuff). If at least one target is hit by one of the effects of this Skill, you can choose to enter the Flying state until your next movement, you do not move by that effect. The effect of Mount on the Movement is not counted for the Range. Critical: Cost 0.

Usable only if a Music Skill is in effect. Your "Dance" skills, "Orations" Skills and "Spectacle" skills get +SLx2 to damage and +SL to the effectiveness level of debuffs, and the target of these skills gets -1d6 to their Reactions checks against them. That effect last until the Round or the end of the Music effects.

Usable against a "Type: Human, Demi-Human" target. The target performs a Mind opposition check against your Magic check. If you succeed, the target will become spent, pacified, and will list to your orders. If the target is not a Mob or a Extra, they can ignore this effect.

You choose a "Oration" Skill, "Music" Skill or a "Chant" with the "Timing: Major Action", you use it immediatly. You cannot use the chosen Skill again until the end of this Main Process. You cannot choose a Skill where the usage requirements is not complet.

You must have [Exceptional Performing Arts Skill] SL1 to learn this Skill. When you learn this skill, choose a General Skill you don't possess that have to effect to generate KE at the Pre-play. You must have the condition to learn the choosen Skill and cannot learn this Skill if you don't have the conditions for at least one of them. The quantity of KE you get at the Pre-play from General Skills are multiplied by 5.

WARNING : This skil can generate a huge amount of money if you autorise multiple KE generation skills. Plan way to use that money, like the Base, or impose a Suite livestyle at minimum for the Skill to take effect.
A ballad infuse with magical energy. The targets get +1d6 to their Magic Check until you use another "Music" Skill, you take at least 1 HP of damage, or until the end of this Scene. Critical: Cost 0.

Usable only when the effect of a "Music" Skill you perform is active and end it immediatly. All targets gets +2d6 to all dices rolls and checks. You cannot do another "Music" while this effect is active, and it last until you take at least 1 HP of damage or until the end of this Round. After that, you use any "Music" Skill until the end of this Scene, but you are always considered to be under the effect of a "Music" Skill for other Skills.

A chant that from the heart and raise courage. The targets gets +1d6 to the Hit checks of their Weapon attacks until you use another "Music" Skill, you take at least 1 HP of damage, or until the end of this Scene. Critical: Cost 0.
A melody that vibrate muscles and soul. The targets get +1d6 to Dodge checks until you use another "Music" Skill, you take at least 1 HP of damage, or until the end of this Scene. Critical: Cost 0.
A mystic chant of forgotten times. The targets get +1d6 to all Mind checks until you use another "Music" Skill, you take at least 1 HP of damage, or until the end of this Scene. Critical: Cost 0.
Persuade the target that they end is close and inevitable.The target performs a Mind opposition check. If you win, the target take 2d6+CLx3 piercing damage at the Cleanup Phase. Critical: Add dices.

Praise the target and rouse their ego. They gets Regeneration(SL+1). That effect heal them of 5 HP at each Cleanup Phase then lose 1 to the effectiveness level. This effect end when the effectiveness level drop to 0 or when the HP are equal to the Max HP. The effectiveness level can by raise by skills that raise the effectiveness level of debuff. Critical: Cost 0.
Persuade the target they entered contact with poison. The target performs a Mind opposition check. If you win, apply Poison(SL+1) to the target. Critical: Cost 0.
Hurls vulgar and insulting words at the target. The target perform a Mind opposition check. If you win, apply Enraged and Intimidated to the target. Critical: Cost 0.
Whispers rumors about the target in their ear. The target perform a Mind opposition check. If you win, apply Dazed and Knockback(2). Critical: Cost 0.

You must have [Dance: Forbidden Dance] SL2 to learn this Skill. You can use your [Dance: Forbidden Dance] at the Setup Phase. This skill is considered to be a Dancer Skill "Step: ~~" and considered to be under a skill like that until the end of the round when you use it.
The last part of the effect is for synergy with the Dancer class, not necessary if you don't play with it.
Effective only when attacking an opponent suffering from any Debuff. Add your Mind to yours Hit checks and damage you deal. That effect lasts until the end of this Main Process.

Choose one "Spectacle" Skill with "Timing: Major Action", you use it immediatly. You cannot use the chosen Skill again until the end of this Main Process. You cannot choose a Skill where the usage requirements is not complet. You retrieve one object you drop or lost in this Scene.

Produce a balloon that you throw at the target. Perform a ranged attack against the target. That attack deal 2d6+5 physical damage. If the target loses at least 1 HP from this damage, apply Off-balance on them. Critical: Add dices.

Produce a hoop that you throw at the target. Perform a ranged attack against the target. That attack deal 2d6+5 physical damage. If the target loses at least 1 HP from this damage, apply Intimidated on them. Critical: Add dices.

Produce a magical knife you throw at the target. Perform a ranged attack against the target. Add 1d6 to the Dexterity check for that attack. That attack deal 2d6+5 physical damage. Critical: Add dices.

Usable when you are the target of a ranged weapon attack. Performs a Dexterity opposition check against the attack. If you win, choose a target, that become the new target of the attack (they can react to that attack like normally and that can be the attacker itself). The attacker and the new target need to be both in Vision.

Produce a Ribbon that you unfurl over the target. Perform a ranged attack against the target. That attack deal 2d6+5 physical damage. If the target loses at least 1 HP from this damage, they gets -1d6 to all their Damage Roll until the end of this Round. Critical: Add dices.

Send a smile to the target's face. The target use a Major Action immediately without entering their Main Process. That Major Action will not make the target spent and can be used even if they're spent. The target can refuse the effect, in this case, this use of the Skill does not count toward your use limit.

You know how to break a fall if necessary.

Add 1d6 to your Perception checks for listening or scouting.

Add 1d6 to your Perception checks for attempting to discern someone in the Stealth state, or trying to stay in Stealth state.
Add CL to your Max MP. You may not learn both this Skill and [Vitality]

The Advanced Masteries Skills are General Skill that enable player a better focus on their prime class. It's a solution a created because of the increase of class Homebrew. I think they do nicely even with the original class, but they're not has much of a necessity. They're only 5 Advanced Masteries, one for each Advanced Class and the Adventurer. The Advanced Mastery are powerfull but have heavy requirement, some base ability need to be a least 15 and 12 (like the rule of Low-Level Advanced Class) and both the Expert Skill and Focus of a certain class is needed (or the Advanced Class Imitation Skill for the Adventurer), making it also an investment of General Skill and force to at least commit a little in a certain class.
